test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the statement that is correct according to the passage.

options.text: Scientific research has proven that ice-creams worsen cold symptoms.
The author's grandson was advised to consume ice-creams to treat his cold.
Unlearning preconceived notions is a tough thing to do.
Unlearning preconceived notions is an effortless process.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The author explicitly states that **dropping preconceived notions is difficult, reflecting on the challenge of unlearning**. (Paragraph 2)
 
• There is a clear acknowledgment of the difficulty in changing long-held beliefs and ideas. (Paragraph 2)

**Therefore, the correct answer is "Unlearning preconceived notions is a tough thing to do".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option (1)** is contradicted by the passage, which mentions the lack of scientific evidence.
 
• **Option (2)** misrepresents the advice given; the grandchild was allowed to have a popsicle, not prescribed ice cream as a treatment.
 
• **Option (4)** is directly contradicted by the passage.
